scope: Implementation facts for the root-assigned fresh Astra FedDyn prose writer; no standalone prose added by implementer.

algorithm.local_history: h_i_next=h_i+y_i-x, once after successful local updates; not a measured-gradient vector
algorithm.cloud: unweighted mean of all selected endpoints + mean of every logical history in the fixed population
algorithm.sample_mode: q_i=N*n_i/sum_all_n; alpha_i=alpha/q_i. Full realized positive integer count vector is mandatory. Counts never weight either model/history mean.
algorithm.labels: No label-dependent coefficient. Matching output-column and label permutation preserves complete objective gradients.
algorithm.optimization: Finite local plain SGD, without a convergence claim. No equation change to legacy unsquared FedProx.

public_entrypoints.client: Composable default payload/transport/reporting with example-local lifecycle and training adapters. Full model and versioned round metadata, bound to actual assignment header.
public_entrypoints.server: examples/customized_client_training/feddyn/feddyn_server.py::Server owns all population histories, count cache, run UUID, committed round and consumed dispatch tokens. Full synchronous fixed-population rounds only.
public_entrypoints.trainer: Dedicated example Trainer plus preserved FedDynLossStrategy/FedDynUpdateStrategy/FedDynLossStrategyFromConfig imports. Corrected training refuses missing versioned dispatch.
public_entrypoints.local_loss_api: alpha zero gives task-only loss locally; full example requires positive alpha. adaptive_alpha flag must match configured weighting and needs authoritative population count metadata.

configuration.toml_changes: Added weighting key and explanatory comments; all prior scalar TOML values unchanged.
configuration.supported: ordinary torch module, nonempty fixed trainable Q; dense finite float32/float64 tensors; fixed plain SGD with one positive finite lr; ordinary or accumulated updates; nonempty realized sampler and drop_last=false. Frozen parameters and static float/integer/bool buffers are transported but absent from history and remain baseline-identical.
configuration.rejected: async/urgent/cross-silo, DP/nonbasic trainer, nonSGD, momentum/dampening/weight decay/nesterov/maximize, AMP/clipping, actual scheduler, mutable nontrainables, shared parameter aliases, changed flags/shapes or optimizer ownership, empty/zero-epoch/all-skipped attempts.

state_and_migration.live_history_authority: server only; no child/client canonical history file is written or implicitly loaded
state_and_migration.worker: provisional result identity/model/history/count/step state; parent loads matching model and current handoff before acceptance and outbound eligibility. Example-local rollback covers owned model tensors, parameter flags/gradients, strategy and context on failed model/save/state/handoff.
state_and_migration.read_only_legacy: FedDynUpdateStrategy.read_legacy_history(context): canonical contained feddyn_grad_ID.pth wins over exact accepted-B root+"_feddyn_grad_ID.pth"; same positive logical ID only, never client0. Full recognized frozen extras may be inspected then excluded from Q; corruption remains visible; bytes unchanged.
state_and_migration.save_path: Read-only legacy inspection location, never live training authority; attempts to train with it fail actionably.
state_and_migration.trajectory: No implicit continuation of old mathematically different state. Explicit Server.warm_start_model(weights) starts new UUID/round0/all histories0. Model-only export cannot resume corrected FedDyn.
state_and_migration.checkpoint: One atomically replaced weights_only-readable complete CPU bundle at checkpoint_path/checkpoint_name("feddyn", model_name, suffix=".pth"). Complete model/all-N histories/config/schema/counts/committed round/run/token ledger and RNG. Ordinary feddyn_lenet5.pth; unsafe/long names use the shared collision-safe codec.
state_and_migration.rng: Python global and owned selection/context-selection are separately saved, plus NumPy global including Gaussian cache and Torch default CPU. Validated pending RNG is consumed exactly once in local start before inherited listener/registration. Rejected validation/install retains prior live/pending state. In-flight/process/GPU continuation is outside the contract.
state_and_migration.round_boundary: Dispatch round is separate from committed round. Save publishes coherent last committed snapshot. Whole batch and post-receive callback payload validation precede arithmetic. Aggregation/load/callback rejection restores known model/history/count/token/identity state; postcommit evaluation/report failure retains the algorithm commit. No arbitrary external callback side-effect rollback.

Deferred train_process retains provisional controls until child model save/export and parent matching handoff acceptance. Failed train_model owns its rejection cleanup; failed post-model process handoff owns its cleanup. Primary and secondary end/cleanup exceptions remain visible as BaseExceptionGroup.
